title: Silas and the Alibi
author: S. M. Amberdale
blurb: Ulyana Vane, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
